question: Which country is the biggest producer of rice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China** is the **biggest producer** of rice in the world, producing around **146 million metric tons** of rice in **2019.**
 
• **Rice** is a **staple food** in China and is consumed by a large population.
 
• It is also** exported** to other countries.
 
• **Russia **is **not **a major producer of rice as it has a **cold climate **and rice cultivation is **not feasible **there.
 
• **Brazil **is a major producer of crops like **soybean, corn, and coffee**, but it is not a major producer of rice.
 
• **Bangladesh** is a significant producer of rice, but its production is **much lower** than China.
 
• Bangladesh produced around **35 million metric tons **of rice in **2019.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rice** is the **staple food** for more than **half of the world's population.**
 
• Other major rice-producing countries include** India, Indonesia, Vietnam, and Thailand.**
 
• **Russia** is a major producer of **wheat, barley,** and other grains.
 
• **Brazil** is the largest producer of** coffee **in the world and is also a major producer of **soybeans, corn, and sugar.**
 
• **Bangladesh** is a densely populated country and** rice** is the **staple food **there.
 
• Hence, the statement "The correct answer is** option 2 (China)"** is correct.
